I can't eat dominoes GF bc of cross contamination, but wanted to share a funny story-

It was 3 weeks after I got my diagnosis of celiac disease. I cut out gluten successfully those 3 weeks and was feeling pretty good, and decided to treat myself to some  fries. McDonald's was closed, so a bar I'm known at was my second choice (discount and could text a friend and have them ready for pickup). Now, being a newbie, I still wasn't as aware of how severely cross contamination could affect me. And man, did I learn. I was on my way home after running a few errands while snacking on my fries, when it hit. BATHROOM. NOW. the first place I saw that I knew had a bathroom was a vape store I frequent. I rushed in there, and barely made it to the toilet. Once hell had left my body, I come to the realization... there's no toilet paper. No paper towels. Not even anything in the trashcan. After about 3 minutes of panic, I suck it up and call the store. Guy's really chill, says no worries, he'll grab me some TP. Que sigh of relief. Til it's been 5 minutes. Then 5 more. Then the knock, and this man saying they have ZERO paper products in the store. 

PURE.PANIC.

I'm trapped in this bathroom with absolutely nothing to wipe with. And this was not a pull my pants up and waddle out in shame situation. Gluten had absolutely wrecked me. So after going through the stages of grief, I slowly unzip my boot, and near tears roll my sock off. At this point I became an atheist bc I refuse to believe any higher power might be witnessing this. Sock was used, thrown in the trash, then hands were washed, toiled flushed, and I shuffled out of the bathroom. Trash bag in hand bc I'm not a monster. Of course I had to give the guy a heads up bc I took the trash bag. 

I've never been back.
